title: Influence at a Glance
text:
Brands spend billions of dollars every year on advertising. Their goal is to influence how people think and what they buy. Many campaigns rely on celebrities, because audiences tend to trust familiar faces. Yet this strategy can backfire when the public feels misled.

Social media has changed the way products are promoted. Influencers share sponsored content with millions of followers, often without clear labels. Regulators have therefore started to demand more transparency. As a result, companies must now disclose their paid partnerships.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why do many campaigns use celebrities?
options: Because celebrities are cheaper than other advertisers
Because audiences tend to trust familiar faces
Because television is no longer used

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do regulators now demand?
What can be inferred about an advertising strategy that relies on celebrities?
options: It can damage a brand if people feel deceived

questions.text: Why might sponsored content shared by influencers be a concern?
options: Because followers may not realize it is paid advertising
Because influencers never reach large audiences
Because labels make content more expensive
Because social media is no longer popular

vocabulary.definition: to affect how someone thinks, feels or acts
organized series of actions to promote a product or idea
to have the opposite of the intended effect
the quality of being open and easy to understand

paragraph_translations: Marki co roku wydają miliardy dolarów na reklamę. Ich celem jest wpływanie na to, jak ludzie myślą i co kupują. Wiele kampanii opiera się na znanych osobach, ponieważ odbiorcy chętnie ufają znanym twarzom. Ta strategia może jednak przynieść odwrotny skutek, gdy społeczeństwo poczuje się wprowadzone w błąd.

Media społecznościowe zmieniły sposób promowania produktów. Influencerzy udostępniają sponsorowane treści milionom obserwatorów, często bez wyraźnych oznaczeń. Dlatego regulatorzy zaczęli domagać się większej przejrzystości. W rezultacie firmy muszą teraz ujawniać swoje płatne współprace.
